free_tier.stated: 5 GB mailbox per account, free 100 MB web hosting with a domain, no database

tooling: any IMAP client, per the MX Plan documentation
chaining: the cheapest route to a real mailbox with a custom domain, at the cost of a domain and a hosting plan at OVH.

limits.value: one mailbox per domain on the free activation, with regional variation

identity_cost.detail: an OVH account with a payment method. Activation also needs a domain at OVH, which is a second gate and is recorded in the limits rather than in the identity kind, because identity_cost carries one value

reliability_note: the free activation depends on a domain and a hosting plan at OVH, with regional variation

evidence.proved: the free Mail MX activation bundled with a Start 10M hosting plan
MX Plan mail is used through webmail or an email client, with IMAP, POP and SMTP settings given for a user, for which the schema has no term, and the guide documents no WebDAV access
evidence.quote: Once you have created your email addresses, you can start using them. There are two ways of doing this: using webmail from a browser, or using an email client.

evidence.proved: IMAP is at imap.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net for the Europe and Africa zone
an MX Plan mailbox is read over IMAP, or over POP
evidence.quote: When you choose your account type, we recommend using IMAP to receive emails. However, you can select POP as well.

evidence.proved: IMAP uses port 993 with SSL/TLS for the Europe and Africa zone
evidence.quote: Server (incoming): imap.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net. - Port: 993. - Security type: SSL/TLS.

evidence.proved: POP is at pop.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net on port 995 with SSL/TLS for the Europe and Africa zone
evidence.quote: Server (incoming): pop.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net. - Port: 995. - Security type: SSL/TLS.

evidence.proved: SMTP uses port 465 with SSL/TLS for the Europe and Africa zone
evidence.quote: Server (outgoing): smtp.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net. - Port: 465. - Security type: SSL/TLS.

evidence.proved: SMTP is at smtp.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net for the Europe and Africa zone
the MX Plan guide was captured on 2026-11-02 and gives the IMAP and POP settings
evidence.quote: When you choose your account type, we recommend using IMAP to receive emails. However, you can select POP as well.

evidence.proved: the MX Plan guide still documents IMAP, POP and SMTP client access

interface_detail: webmail from a browser, and an email client over IMAP (imap.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net, port 993, SSL/TLS), POP (pop.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net, port 995, SSL/TLS) and SMTP (smtp.mail.ovh.net or ssl0.ovh.net, port 465, SSL/TLS) in the Europe and Africa zone
limits_note: the 5 GB is a mailbox storage volume and not an object size, so no kind in the six-value vocabulary names it. One mailbox per domain is the count that shapes the tier
